title: Proving a Secret Arrived
description: A snippet that confirms the token is present without exposing a single character of it.

steps.description: This snippet proves the token arrived without revealing it. It checks whether the variable is set.
`[ -n "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-}" ]` tests that the variable is non-empty. If it is set, the `echo` prints the length, not the value.
If the token is missing, the script prints a message to standard error and exits with status 1.
